title: Roof Replacement in Oregon City, OR
summary: In October 2026, French Roofing completed a roof replacement on a home in Oregon City, OR. The new roof is CertainTeed Landmark architectural shingles in a dark gray, finished with new ridge cap and new flashings around the plumbing vent pipes.
scope: Installed new CertainTeed Landmark architectural shingles
Capped the ridges and hips with new ridge cap shingles
New flashings around the plumbing vent pipes
